description: Rate a Close Knit answer by its callId (none: the last answer): rating 1-5, what was good, what was bad or missing, the fix you would want. Use it for the last answer in a conversation; earlier ones go in the next call's rate_previous. It describes the answer, never the user. Stored for 90 days with the call's intent summary, tool, client name and the conversation's one-way tag, contact details and full postcodes removed, no IP address or user agent.

bad.description: [input value] What was wrong, missing or confusing.
bad.title: Bad

call_id.description: [id] The callId of the answer you are rating; leave it out when answers carry none.
call_id.title: Call Id

fix.description: [input value] The change to the tool or its answer you would want.
fix.title: Fix

good.description: [input value] What was useful in the answer.
good.title: Good

rating.description: [input value] 1 = useless or wrong, 3 = usable with gaps, 5 = exactly what was needed.
rating.title: Rating

name: rate_answer
title: Rate answer
